# Rachel Chidester — Professional Profile

Website for Rachel Chidester, a Michigan-based program manager with experience in scientific research operations, education and fellowship programs, healthcare, reporting, budgets, and process improvement.

- Resume HTML: ./index.html
- Structured resume: ./resume.json
- Plain-text resume: ./resume.txt
- Downloadable PDF resume: ./Rachel_Chidester_Resume.pdf
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/rachelchidester/

Relevant expertise: scientific research program coordination, nonprofit and international educational programs, stakeholder management, budgets and grant reporting, process improvement, Power BI, Dynamics CRM, Microsoft Power Platform, clinical team communication, and incident response.

The site does not claim direct experience in biomedical drug-development research, formal clinical trial operations, or currently active athletic trainer certification.
